desc: An essential tool for training and home defense, the CF-SHIELD projects a bright red aiming point downrange. It's the perfect compliment to S&W's M&P SHEILD. The CF-SHIELD mounts to the frame without any permanent alteration to the pistol and it offer ambidextrous switching to accommodate both right and left-handed shooters. It also features a reinforced nylon design, easily programmable for steady on or pulsed beam, 10 minute automatic time out to prevent battery drain, a TAP ON/OFF switch to reinforce safe handling and it's fully adjustable for windage and elevation.Ambidextrous TAP ON/TAP OFF switch reinforces safe firearm handling
